title: API Client Module
summary: This module provides a set of asynchronous functions for the UI to interact with the application's backend API, handling various operations such as model management, user data, settings, and cloud integration.

nodes.label: Pull Model
nodes.title: Initiate Model Download
nodes.description: Requests the backend to download a specified model, providing real-time progress updates to the UI.

nodes.label: Get Inference Compute Info
nodes.title: Retrieve Inference Compute Details
nodes.description: Fetches information about the available inference compute resources from the backend for display.

nodes.label: Fetch User Chats
nodes.title: Retrieve All User Chat Sessions
nodes.description: Retrieves a list of all chat sessions associated with the current user from the backend.

nodes.label: Update Cloud Setting
nodes.title: Modify Cloud Integration Status
nodes.description: Sends a request to the backend to enable or disable cloud integration and returns the updated status.

nodes.label: Get Model Recommendations
nodes.title: Fetch Recommended Models
nodes.description: Retrieves a list of recommended models from the backend's experimental API for user selection.

nodes.label: Get Cloud Status
nodes.title: Check Cloud Integration Status
nodes.description: Fetches the current status of cloud integration from the backend to inform the UI.

nodes.label: Fetch Application Settings
nodes.title: Retrieve User Settings
nodes.description: Retrieves the current application settings for the user from the backend.

nodes.label: Update Application Settings
nodes.title: Save User Settings
nodes.description: Sends updated application settings to the backend for persistence.

nodes.label: Disconnect User Session
nodes.title: Log Out User
nodes.description: Initiates a request to the backend to sign out the current user session, ending their active session.

nodes.label: Backend API
nodes.title: Application Backend API
nodes.description: The external API endpoint that the UI client communicates with for various operations and data exchange.

groups.label: Model Management
groups.title: Model Interaction & Information
groups.description: Handles operations related to downloading, recommending, and querying inference capabilities of models.

groups.label: User Data & State
groups.title: User-Specific Data and Session Control
groups.description: Manages fetching and updating user chats, application settings, and user session disconnection.

groups.label: Cloud Integration
groups.title: Cloud Service Status and Configuration
groups.description: Provides functions to retrieve and modify the application's cloud integration settings and status.
